hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Identify friend pairs who share zero mutual friends.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Friendships are undirected. Expand the table bidirectionally to find common neighbors between user pairs.

hints.title: Query Structure
hints.text: Self join bidirectional friendships on friend id to collect pairs that share a mutual friend, then filter them out from the original pairs using a left join or not exists.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH AllFriends AS (
    SELECT user_id1 AS u1, user_id2 AS u2 FROM Friends
    UNION ALL
    SELECT user_id2 AS u1, user_id1 AS u2 FROM Friends
),
Mutual AS (
    SELECT a.u1, b.u1 AS u2
    FROM AllFriends a
    JOIN AllFriends b ON a.u2 = b.u2 AND a.u1 != b.u1
)
SELECT f.user_id1, f.user_id2
FROM Friends f
LEFT JOIN Mutual m ON f.user_id1 = m.u1 AND f.user_id2 = m.u2
WHERE m.u1 IS NULL
ORDER BY f.user_id1, f.user_id2;
```

complexity.notes: Bidirectional expansion and self join on common neighbor.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring undirected symmetry omits mutual connections stored in reverse order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(E) auxiliary space for bidirectional friend list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly expand undirected edges and filter out pairs sharing mutual friends.
